limitations: Finite positive-width planks and a strictly interior axis-aligned nondegenerate box hole; planar optimizer rigidity only when the exposed-side sum is strictly below the shortest outer side. Other optimizer regimes and higher-dimensional optimizer rigidity are open here.
scientific_integrity: Analytic theorem using cited directional Bang-box lemmas and a planar equality argument. The computer verifier is a finite check, not a proof. Novelty is provisional; previously known unit-cube thresholds and unit-square optimizer rigidity are not claimed as new.
title: Exact plank-covering threshold for rectangular-box annuli and planar optimizer rigidity
